blocks.title: Comprehensive project planning
blocks.text: Comprehensive project planning means thinking about all the details of your project before you start: understanding what needs to be done, who will do it and how it will be done.

Some of the largest software development companies in the world are worth billions of dollars. For example, as of 2023 Microsoft had a market capitalization exceeding 2 trillion dollars, which shows the economic importance of software development in today's digital age (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: What is a crucial aspect of comprehensive project planning (MCQ 7)?
blocks.explanation: Understanding the project scope and tasks, option (a). The book's answer key gives (c), 'hiring a large development team', which does not follow from the text.

items: Comprehensive planning: decide what is to be done, who will do it and how, before starting.
